summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to remove the income limitation on the exclusion from gross income for Olympic and Paralympic medals and prize money, making all such awards tax-exempt regardless of the recipient's income, effective for awards received after December 31, 2025.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude Olympic and Paralympic medal and prize money from gross income, effectively lowering taxes for a specific group of individuals. This is the central purpose of the bill.
